about: Second routing check for the methods rung, written 2026-11-14 before any of these wordings were run and before the shortlist and contrastive-confirm change. 'method' lists every method that answers the question; null means the recipe tiers or the takeover rung should answer. A few wordings are close to a method's own example phrasings (settlement bridge, change attribution, pathway, early signal), so this set is not harder than the first. Scored on which rung and method answered, not on the figures.
